title: output: ticks.tbl and summary.tbl through toil
body: ticks.tbl is long: t, pid, name, concurrency, threads, rss. summary.tbl is one row per process: pid, ppid, name, start, end, wall, cpu, serial, parallel, mean, max. #= lines carry the interval, the threshold and the command. Named so a stage tree or a ledger can join on pid or name.
close_reason: src/output.rs: ticks.tbl streamed per tick, summary.tbl, tree.tbl and levels.tbl at the end, #= lines with interval, threshold, command, status, rusage and accounted cpu
